description: Verify that the parser captures the rule requiring a hazard analysis for each type of food manufactured, processed, packed, or held.

input_data.requirement_text: Conduct hazard analysis for each type of food

steps: Load the parsed requirements.json file.
Search for requirement_id REQ-117.130-001A.
Confirm that the description refers to conducting a hazard analysis for each type of food.
Verify that the parent is REQ-117.130-001.
notes: This checks that the main hazard analysis requirement was not skipped during parsing.

description: Verify that the system identifies known hazards as a required part of the hazard analysis.
steps: Open requirements.json.
Locate REQ-117.130-001B.
Check that the requirement description includes known hazards.
Confirm the requirement is included in the selected atomic rule set.
notes: This validates that known hazards are treated as their own atomic rule.

description: Verify that reasonably foreseeable hazards are extracted as a separate atomic requirement.
steps: Read the generated requirements.json file.
Compare its description to the CFR source text.
Confirm that it is not merged with the known hazards rule.
notes: This checks atomicity because known hazards and reasonably foreseeable hazards should be separate checks.

description: Verify that the hazard analysis must evaluate hazards using data, experience, illness data, scientific reports, or similar information.

input_data.requirement_text: Evaluate hazards using data, experience, reports

steps: Load requirements.json.
Search for REQ-117.130-001D.
Check that the rule describes evaluating hazards using supporting information.
Confirm that the rule remains under parent REQ-117.130-001.
notes: This test is meant to catch missing evaluation language.

description: Verify that the parser captures the requirement to determine which hazards require preventive controls.
steps: Read requirements.json.
Locate REQ-117.130-001E.
Verify that preventive controls are mentioned in the description.
Confirm that the test case maps to the same requirement_id.
notes: This checks one of the most important V&V requirements in the section.

description: Verify that the hazard analysis must be written and not only performed informally.
steps: Open requirements.json.
Search for REQ-117.130-001F.
Confirm that the description states the hazard analysis must be written.
Check that expected_structure.json includes child F under REQ-117.130-001.
notes: This verifies the documentation requirement separately from the analysis requirement.

description: Verify that biological hazards are included under hazard identification.
steps: Load requirements.json.
Confirm that the rule identifies biological hazards.
Verify that the parent requirement is REQ-117.130-002.
notes: This checks the biological hazard category in the hazard identification section.

description: Verify that chemical hazards are included as a hazard category that must be considered.
steps: Open requirements.json.
Search for REQ-117.130-002B.
Confirm that the description refers to chemical hazards.
Check that the rule is included in test_cases.json.
notes: This test confirms that chemical hazards are not skipped or mislabeled.

description: Verify that physical hazards are represented as a required hazard category.
steps: Read requirements.json.
Locate REQ-117.130-002C.
Verify that physical hazards appear in the description.
Confirm that the generated expected structure includes child C for REQ-117.130-002.
notes: This validates the third major hazard category.

description: Verify that identified hazards are evaluated as part of the hazard evaluation section.
steps: Load requirements.json.
Search for REQ-117.130-003A.
Confirm that the description requires evaluation of identified hazards.
Run validate_outputs.py to verify the requirement and test case mapping passes.
notes: This connects the selected rule set to the hazard evaluation parent requirement.
